name: Vildagliptin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Type 2 diabetes (monotherapy, with metformin, a glitazone or insulin)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 50 mg twice daily (morning and evening); maximum 100 mg/day
50 mg once daily in the morning

key_interactions.action: Consider a lower sulfonylurea or insulin dose.

serious: Bullous or exfoliative skin lesions, cutaneous vasculitis

contraindications: Do not use in hepatic impairment, including baseline ALT or AST more than 3 times the upper limit of normal (SmPC 4.2, 4.4; not a formal 4.3 contraindication)
monitoring: Liver function tests at baseline, every 3 months in year 1, then periodically
Kidney function to set the dose

pk.peak: About 1.7 hours fasting (2.5 hours with food)
pk.half_life_eskd: Not stated; exposure (AUC) about 1.4-, 1.7- and 2-fold higher in mild, moderate and severe impairment
pk.metabolism: Hydrolysis (about 69% of dose), not cytochrome P450; main metabolite LAY 151 inactive
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 85% of dose in urine (23% unchanged); 15% in feces

sources.citation: European Medicines Agency. (n.d.). Galvus (vildagliptin): EPAR product information [Summary of product characteristics]. Novartis Europharm Limited. Retrieved November 17, 2026.
Novartis Pharmaceuticals UK Ltd. (2023). Galvus 50 mg tablets (vildagliptin) [Summary of product characteristics; text revised June 22, 2023]. Electronic Medicines Compendium (UK).

draft_notes: SmPC also states vildagliptin should not be used with hepatic impairment, including pretreatment ALT or AST above 3 times the upper limit of normal; listed under monitoring rather than contraindications because 4.3 lists hypersensitivity only.

revision_log.change: No numeric change; UK SmPC (Jun 2023) cited; unverified EU revision date removed from the citation. Optional Lukashevich 2013 citation not added.
Hepatic-impairment restriction added to contraindications (labeled as SmPC 4.2/4.4).
